summary: 周日。SirSpudlington 提交 EIP-7932 重构，使其更适配 EIP-8141 与 EIP-8164，把签名正式区分为自主签名与分离签名，并拆分预编译。ACDE #236 议程发布，会议定于 5 月 7 日。EliBenSasson 以链上发工资为例，说明没有隐私加密就无法大规模采用。

items.title: EIP-7932：拆分预编译并加入自主与分离签名支持
items.note: （SirSpudlington）提交：为更好配合 EIP-8141 与 EIP-8164，把签名形式化为自主签名（Autonomous）与分离签名（Detached），并重命名相关恢复函数。
items.title_en: EIP-7932: separate the precompile and add autonomous and detached signature support
items.note_en: (SirSpudlington), submitted: to work better with EIP-8141 and EIP-8164, signatures are formalized as autonomous or detached and the recovery functions are renamed.

summary_en: A Sunday. SirSpudlington submitted an EIP-7932 refactor to suit EIP-8141 and EIP-8164 better, formalizing autonomous and detached signatures and separating the precompile. The ACDE #236 agenda was posted for May 7. EliBenSasson used onchain payroll to argue crypto cannot reach mass adoption without privacy.
